goal: Move attribute parsing helper out of QueryParser into a dedicated helper class to reduce class size and isolate attribute-specific logic while preserving the public API.

ops.details: Create a new package-private helper class org.jsoup.select.QueryParserAttributeHelper with a static method evaluatorForAttribute(String attributeContent, String query) that encapsulates the previous evaluatorForAttribute(TokenQueue) implementation. The helper will create and close its own TokenQueue (try-with-resources) and return an Evaluator.

Move the implementation of evaluatorForAttribute from QueryParser into QueryParserAttributeHelper as a static method that takes the chomped attribute content string and the original query string. Adjust local references (use local TokenQueue created from the passed content string).

Update QueryParser.byAttribute() to call the new helper: return QueryParserAttributeHelper.evaluatorForAttribute(tq.chompBalanced('[', ']'), query); Remove the old try-with-resources and the old evaluatorForAttribute method from QueryParser.
